name: B10-0445/2025 – After § 39 – Am 6
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 39a. Expresses concern about the lack of transparency and political neutrality in the allocation of EU financial resources to non-governmental organisations, eco-terrorists and lobbying groups advocating for the so-called green transition; calls on the Commission to ensure full transparency regarding the public funding of such entities, including the disclosure of their lobbying activities and institutional affiliations; underlines that public funds should not be used to promote ideological agendas or to unilaterally influence democratic debate in the fields of climate and energy policy;
